summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting a reverse share split at a 1-for-10 ratio approved by the board on April 6, 2026. The par value changes from $0.000025 to $0.00025, and authorized capital is adjusted to $500,000 divided into 2 billion ordinary shares. The split is effective May 1, 2026, and shares will trade on Nasdaq under the same symbol TLIH with a new CUSIP. This is a routine corporate action without any change in control, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. The filing is a routine current report, not a special situation.
